name: Maneuver detection
description: Maneuver detection over any pluggable propagator. detect_maneuvers takes element sets ($OMM) and asks for each set's trajectory on a propagator query port (the host routes each query to the plugged propagator: SGP4, FFM (Full Force Model), an ABI provider; inertial or Earth-fixed answers) or takes per-set trajectories ($OEM), and emits $MNV DETECTED from three detectors: D1, the crossing of consecutive trajectories with a median step test; D2, a robust GLR step test on orbit-averaged energy levels and the orbit-normal chain; D3, a GLR test for a change of energy rate (low thrust). compare_ephemerides checks planned maneuvers ($MNV) against successive operator ephemeris versions ($OEM: executed, cancelled or unknown, with the executed delta-V) and reports changes between versions. score_detections matches detected $MNV to truth $MNV (recall, time error, delta-V ratio, false alarms). Each method reports one $MDE (maneuver detection evidence: the detect, compare or score report arm); the propagation queries are one $PRW WINDOW_REQUEST. Delta-V is in UVW (U radial, V in-track, W cross-track, km/s), and every emitted $MNV carries PROVENANCE: this module and its version as PRODUCER, and the source that the element sets or the planned maneuver name. Options are the node configuration (plugin.getConfig, a ModuleConfig FlatBuffer read through sdm_piv::get_config), never an input frame: detect_maneuvers, compare_ephemerides and score_detections read the same keys the options object had (lists as StringList/NumberList, spans/explained/assessed as TableList).

sequentialJustification.detail: Deterministic statistics over caller-supplied element sets, trajectories and records. One host call, plugin.getConfig (the options); no threads, propagation or network access: trajectories come from the caller through the propagator query port.

inputPorts.description: Element sets ($OMM, plain or a stream of size-prefixed records): the module asks for their trajectories on propagation_requests and reads the answers on propagation. Grouped by NORAD_CAT_ID (else OBJECT_ID, else OBJECT_NAME); one set per EPOCH (a later record replaces an earlier one).

Answers to propagation_requests: one $OEM data block per query, in query order (a refused set: an empty block whose COMMENT begins REFUSED). UTC, km and km/s, Earth-centred inertial or Earth-fixed axes (Earth-fixed states are turned to TEME by GMST).

Per-set trajectories supplied by the caller, instead of element sets: one data block per element set spanning its neighbouring sets' epochs (two on each side), grouped by object and ordered by the midpoint of their span.

outputPorts.description: One $MNV frame per detected maneuver, STATUS DETECTED.

The trajectories the detector needs, when element sets arrive without answers: one $PRW with the WINDOW_REQUEST arm, one PRWWindowQuery per element set (SET_INDEX = its record among the element_sets records, in input order; START/STOP its neighbour_sets-th neighbours each side; STEP_SECONDS = grid_step_s). Answer on propagation: one $OEM data block per query in SEQUENCE order.

One $MDE with the DETECT_REPORT arm: run status (NeedsPropagation with the query count, or Detected), duplicate epochs and refused sets, the options used, and per object its crossing pairs, levels (report_levels), every event each detector raised with its evidence, and the emitted events (MNV_ID names each $MNV).

inputPorts.description: Ephemeris versions: one $OEM per version (CREATION_DATE is its issue time), one data block per object.
Planned maneuvers ($MNV): EVENT_START_TIME the TIG, DELTA_VEL the planned size (km/s), SAT_NO or ORIG_OBJECT_ID the object.

outputPorts.description: Each planned maneuver checked (STATUS EXECUTED, CANCELLED or UNKNOWN, with the executed delta-V), and version changes above unplanned_threshold_km (STATUS DETECTED).

One $MDE with the COMPARE_REPORT arm: per object the version changes (mode, window, delta SMA, in-track and cross-track delta-V) and each planned maneuver check (pre and post versions, modelled and executed change, status), with the counts.

inputPorts.description: Truth maneuvers ($MNV): EVENT_START_TIME to EVENT_END_TIME, delta-V from DELTA_VEL or from MNVR_ACCEL_TIMES / MNVR_ACCELS (U, V, W per point, km/s^2, held until the next time).

outputPorts.description: One $MDE with the SCORE_REPORT arm: recall with its Wilson interval, recall by delta-V bin, time-error and delta-V-ratio distributions, false alarms per object-year, and every match, miss and unmatched detection.
